recentItems.title: Ganpati Bappa Visarjan Hits | Vighnaharta, Hey Ganaraya, Jai Ganesha, Ya Re Ya, Morya Re & More
recentItems.description:
Celebrate the spirit of Ganpati Visarjan with a high-energy collection of devotional favourites and festive Bollywood hits! 🙏🥁✨ From Ya Re Ya, Vighnaharta, Jai Ganesha, Hey Ganaraya, Deva Ho Deva, Morya Re and Dev Deva to energetic dance favourites like Zingaat, Dolby Walya, Kala Chashma, Sauda Khara Khara, First Class and Main Nikla Gaddi Leke — this jukebox brings together the perfect soundtrack for the final celebrations of Ganpati Bappa.

Let the dhol, beats and festive energy make your Ganpati Visarjan celebration even more memorable! ❤️🙏
